crossRefs.note: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.
I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us…
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly…
Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

translations.web: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
translations.bsb: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
translations.kjv: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
translations.asv: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, That I might observe thy word.
